title: UserProfileCyberRequirements
description: What a request that names the profile must allow to get the relaxed safeguards of the profile's `active` tiers. A field reads `true` when at least one of those tiers has the requirement and Anthropic has not waived it on that tier for the profile. A request that does not meet a requirement is still served, without the relaxed safeguards of the tiers that have it. The values differ between profiles and can change, so read them rather than assuming them.

data_retention.description: Whether Anthropic must be able to retain the request's inference data.

human_review.description: Whether Anthropic personnel must be allowed to review the data retained from the request.
